label: Full divine bundle: profile-specific admissibility and same-bearer GOD_4 application (#1864)
summary: Follow-on to draft PR #1865. Twelve is not the completed divine profile: StageTwo's nine attributes, omnipotence, omniscience, moral impeccability and freedom are thirteen selected predicates. World-indexed ExcellenceAt requires them jointly at the same bearer; GreatnessAt adds identical-bearer existence and excellence in all successor worlds, relative to #1865's generic MaximalProfile. Proposed Lean proofs: (a) E-possible joint profile plus a profile-specific world-admissibility condition yields M-possible profile without blanket E ⊆ M; (b) Euclidean M and a local reflexive edge M(w,w), weaker than S5, bring the same bearer and its full profile into the actual world; (c) the existing StageTwo nine-to-field bridge and an explicit, separately OPEN actual-world naming law yield an actual GOD_4 witness and GodExists, not by placing world-invariant IsGod inside a merely possible-world bundle; (d) actual jointly excellent root plus explicit essentiality supports possibility independently of a description-to-world transfer. Proposed finite Bool controls show full E witness without M witness, profile-specific inclusion without blanket inclusion, individually satisfiable omnipotence/omniscience without a joint bearer, and K5 without actuality. Source-reinterpretation or independent philosophical acceptance is not asserted. Best positive warrant is the actual same-root/esse/perfection/intellect-will corpus combined with defeasible recombination; this supports investigation of a partial profile but does not yet give power, full knowledge, moral perfection or freedom in the chosen senses. Best supported incompatibility pressure remains #555's necessary strict-efficacy same-act with a contingent effect; applying it to divine simplicity/freedom is a separate open premise, not a general contradiction. No canonical argument/result registered and no established root premise or computed premise delta; branch PR #1876 awaits CI and independent semantic challenge.
blocker: Substantive #1864 possibility claim remains OPEN: (1) justify metaphysical admissibility of a world jointly realizing all thirteen essential attributes; (2) map currently parameterized attribute senses to fixed metaphysical semantics; (3) supply the actual-world source/causal/GOD_4 naming bridge without assuming GodExists in the witness; (4) establish essentiality of power, knowledge, moral perfection and free capacity for the same actual root. Next tests: nontrivial same-root perfection to actual full bundle, and apply #555's necessary-act strict-efficacy test under a definite free-capacity interpretation. Final-head Lean/CI, binding, frontier comparison and independent semantic review pending.
